title: Validate full live-episode checkpoint carry-over
doing: Propose a bounded synthetic/interruption parity qualification of complete simulator state, raw observation history, held-action phase, per-slot episode counters and model/Adam/RNG/scheduler/normalizer state. Then compare continuation with and without abandonment only after source and resource gates; preserve prior failed attempts. No automatic resume or training launch.
expected: Exact carry-over should prevent systematic loss of the longest live games at segment boundaries. It may not materially improve Q1 because discarded frames were a small fraction; parity failure would block the long-run entry gate.

evidence.label: User priority-order steer, reviewed with current local evidence
Priority reconciliation, observation-only shield and long-run gate
Ordered approval packets with seed counts, hard ceilings and readiness
